smart-autoclicker.module.auto_attack.des: Attacks the mob under your crosshair. Perfect timing waits for a full attack charge, which is the most damage per second with any weapon.
smart-autoclicker.module.auto_eat.desc: Eats the best safe food when you get hungry or hurt, from your offhand or hotbar, then switches back to what you were holding. Never eats rotten flesh, spider eyes, raw chicken, pufferfish or chorus fruit.
smart-autoclicker.module.hold_attack.des: Holds left click to mine continuously. Keeps working while you're tabbed out, and stops before your tool breaks.
smart-autoclicker.module.hold_use.desc: Holds right click (or clicks it repeatedly in Spam mode): block with a shield, place blocks, charge a bow or trident, or eat what's in your hand.
smart-autoclicker.module.auto_walk.desc: Holds a movement key, with optional sprinting, crouching and jumping.
smart-autoclicker.module.mob_sweep.desc: Smoothly turns left and right around where you're facing, so Auto Attack covers a wider area, like two spawner kill chambers side by side. Turns you back when it stops.
smart-autoclicker.module.elytra_cruise.d: Elytra autopilot: fires a rocket whenever you slow down and holds the height you took off at. You steer left and right. Stops at your target distance, when rockets run out, or before the elytra breaks.
smart-autoclicker.preset.mob_grinder.des: Auto Attack + Auto Eat. Stand at your farm's kill spot and walk away.
smart-autoclicker.preset.sweep_grinder.d: Auto Attack + Auto Eat + Mob Sweep, for farms with more than one kill spot.
smart-autoclicker.preset.afk_miner.desc: Hold Left Click + Auto Eat. For cobblestone, basalt and stone generators.
smart-autoclicker.preset.elytra_trip.des: Elytra Cruise + Auto Eat. Jump, open your elytra, and it takes over.
smart-autoclicker.screen.title: Smart Autoclicker
smart-autoclicker.panel.presets.desc: One key starts a whole setup. Click the icons on a card to choose what that preset runs.
smart-autoclicker.panel.safety.desc: When to stop by itself and what to warn you about while you're away.
smart-autoclicker.panel.general.desc: Keys, the status HUD, toasts and sounds.
smart-autoclicker.panel.chip.adds: %s: not included (click to add; it brings %s with it)
smart-autoclicker.panel.chip.conflict: %s can't run with %s. Click to swap it in.
smart-autoclicker.panel.requires: Needs %s, and turns it on for you.
smart-autoclicker.option.module_key.tool: A key that turns this on and off from anywhere in game. Click the box, then press a key.
The key that opens this control panel. Pressing it again closes the panel.
smart-autoclicker.option.key_stop_all.to: The emergency stop key. Works from anywhere in game.
smart-autoclicker.screen.join_world: Join a world to start anything. Settings can be changed from here.
smart-autoclicker.option.attack_timing.t: Perfect: swing only at full attack charge (best damage). Fixed: swing every set number of milliseconds.
smart-autoclicker.option.attack_delay.to: Time between swings when Timing is Fixed Delay. 550 ms is about 1.8 swings a second.
smart-autoclicker.option.attack_hostiles: Zombies, skeletons, endermen, blazes and other hostile mobs.
smart-autoclicker.option.attack_passives: Cows, pigs, chickens and other non-hostile mobs. Handy for animal farms.
Off by default so you never hit a friend who walks in front of you.
smart-autoclicker.option.attack_armor_st: For farms that use an armor stand as a target, including named ones. Off by default so it never knocks over your decorations.
smart-autoclicker.option.protect_named.t: Never hit name-tagged mobs, tamed pets, villagers or golems.
smart-autoclicker.option.eat_at_hunger.t: Eat when your hunger bar drops to this. 20 is full; 14 leaves room for most foods without wasting any.
smart-autoclicker.option.eat_at_health.t: Also eat when your health drops to this, so you heal faster in a fight.
smart-autoclicker.option.golden_food.too: Off by default so your golden and enchanted golden apples are saved for emergencies.
smart-autoclicker.option.restock.tooltip: When your hotbar has no food, move some in from your inventory.
smart-autoclicker.option.use_mode.toolti: Hold: keep right click held down. Spam: click repeatedly at the speed below.
smart-autoclicker.option.use_delay.toolt: Time between right clicks in Spam mode.
smart-autoclicker.option.walk_sprint.too: Sprint while walking forward. Minecraft does not let you sprint while crouching, so this turns Crouch off.
smart-autoclicker.option.walk_crouch.too: Crouch while walking, so you do not walk off edges. Minecraft does not let you sprint while crouching, so this turns Sprint off.
smart-autoclicker.option.walk_jump.toolt: Hold jump too, to hop over blocks or swim up.
smart-autoclicker.option.sweep_width.too: Total angle covered, split evenly left and right of where you started.
smart-autoclicker.option.sweep_period.to: Seconds for one full left-right-left pass.
smart-autoclicker.option.elytra_distance: Stop cruising after flying this many blocks from where you took off.
smart-autoclicker.option.elytra_min_spee: Fire a rocket when your speed drops below this. Rocket-boosted flight is about 33 blocks a second.
smart-autoclicker.option.elytra_camera_f: With a free camera mod on, carries the camera along as you fly, so you can look around and move it without being left behind.
smart-autoclicker.option.elytra_camera_s: With a free camera mod on, turns you toward wherever the camera is facing. Off, you keep flying straight and can look anywhere.
smart-autoclicker.option.elytra_hold_alt: Gently pitch up or down to stay at the height you took off at. Turn off to control pitch yourself.
smart-autoclicker.option.elytra_min_dura: Stop when the elytra has this much durability left, so it never breaks mid-air.
smart-autoclicker.option.keep_running.to: While anything is running, don't open the pause menu when you click away from Minecraft, so it keeps going in the background.
Stop everything when your health drops to this.
smart-autoclicker.option.stop_hit_by_pla: Stop everything as soon as another player hurts you.
smart-autoclicker.option.tool_min_durabi: Stop attacking or mining when the item in your hand has this much durability left, so it never breaks.
smart-autoclicker.option.warn_full.toolt: Show a toast once your inventory fills up while attacking or mining.
smart-autoclicker.option.notify_xp.toolt: Show a toast when you reach this level, e.g. 30 for max enchanting.
smart-autoclicker.option.show_hud.toolti: Show what's running, with live stats, in a corner of the screen.
smart-autoclicker.option.hud_corner.tool: Which corner of the screen the status HUD sits in.
smart-autoclicker.option.toasts.tooltip: Show popups in the top right when things start, stop or need your attention.
smart-autoclicker.option.alert_sounds.to: Play a sound for alerts, so you hear them while tabbed out.
smart-autoclicker.option.flash_taskbar.t: Flash Minecraft's taskbar icon for alerts while you're tabbed out.
smart-autoclicker.hud.title: Smart Autoclicker · %s
smart-autoclicker.toast.out_of_food.desc: No safe food in your inventory or offhand.
smart-autoclicker.toast.inventory_full.d: New drops can't be picked up.
